title: Upgrade NERV's Angular 22.2.6 → 22.3+ and consume @voidbrain/bricks
goal: The workspace runs Angular 22.3 or later and imports @voidbrain/bricks 0.1.0 (tokens, themes, components, surfaces), so the migrated sections are built from bricks rather than copies
acceptance: Every @angular/* package and the Angular CLI and build tooling are on one 22.3.x or later version (bricks 0.1.0 declares peers @angular/core and @angular/common ^22.3.0); package-lock updated with npm ci clean
@voidbrain/bricks 0.1.0 is a pinned dependency; the workspace imports its tokens and themes, and one existing component renders through a bricks component with no visible change
npm run build, npm test (browser tests included) and check:conventions pass; docs/STYLE-GUIDE.md names bricks as the source of tokens and shared components
privacy: Neutral invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A breaking change in the 22.3 update or in bricks that changes how a page looks or behaves goes to the owner
A bricks defect is reported in the bricks repository, not patched in NERV

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: a minor Angular update with ng update, one pinned package, its tokens and themes wired into styles.css, one component swapped as the proof, the style guide line. Not a measurement.
